title: The henselization of a G-ring along an ideal is a G-ring
statement: Let $A$ be a G-ring [def-weil-pbc-g-ring] (in particular Noetherian) and $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, and let $(A^h,I^h)$, $I^h=IA^h$, be the henselization of the pair $(A,I)$ [lem-weil-pbc-pair-henselization]. Then $A^h$ is a G-ring (in particular Noetherian).

source.place: Lemma Tag 0AH3 (lemma-henselization-pair-G-ring, line 12742; reference Greco, Theorem 5.3 i)) and its proof (Lemma 0AGV henselization-Noetherian-pair: $A^h$ Noetherian with the same $I$-adic completion; Lemmas check-G-ring-maximal-ideals, flat-unramified, filtered-colimit-etale-noetherian-fibres)
